6841.title: Global instruction scope and unverified instruction provenance
6841.rootCauseOneLine: The server deliberately reads the same nonempty data-directory AGENTS.md for every project and appends it as user instructions; workspace-specific files use a separate scoped path. The origin of the reported repository-specific global contents is unverified.
6841.proposedFix: Establish global-file provenance and keep repository-specific rules in workspace instructions; do not silently change the documented global-loading contract.
6841.caveats: Shared server runtime boundary tested; no live models, release installer, or reporter installation inspected. No safe automatic source fix was established.
